statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
Symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
Patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks (G45.9)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
It is necessary to correlate arrhythmic events with neurological deficits
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated
The service is needed to establish a definitive diagnosis and guide management
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the requested service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
